decision_rule.legacy_shared_retry: ordinary-first; after fault, generate 3 retry units per tick while retry queue is nonempty only in feedback-on case; safety receives remaining capacity
decision_rule.debt_shed_reserved: during fault reserve one safety unit; on first recovered tick cancel all retry debt (primary work is never cancelled); thereafter generate no retries, serve safety first up to one unit, then ordinary work
decision_rule.no_retry_shared: no feedback retries and no debt cancellation; ordinary-first shared service; safety receives remaining capacity
decision_rule.fallback_authority: never; all rows must have authority_admissions=0
